Я создал SerboTalk, потому что учить сло: I created SerboTalk because learning words with flashcards or apps like Duolingo is primarily about building vocabulary. To start having conversations, you need to open your mouth and speak: choose the words yourself and put them together into phrases.
Так родилась идея простого, лёгкого прил: That led to the idea of a simple, lightweight app for practising a wide range of everyday phrases. An A1–A2 vocabulary is enough to start working on speaking itself: saying words and whole sentences on your own.
Мне хотелось создать короткий путь от «я: I wanted to build a short path from “I know these words” to “I can say this” — and help people get comfortable using Serbian in everyday life sooner.
LESS THEORY. MORE OF YOUR VOICE.
